Urban2Vec uses street-view imagery and POIs; it does not use a remote-sensing input in this reproduction. Availability follows the embedding manifest.
MuseCL uses street-view imagery, remote-sensing imagery, and POI inputs; the release provides the frozen region embeddings, not raw inputs. Availability follows the embedding manifest.
GeoTessera/API-derived raster representation; prepared city/task exports are provided in the model artifact package. Availability follows the embedding manifest.
Frozen task-grid rasters plus exact pre-normalization sample_id tables for native land-use rows; source city rasters are not redistributed. Availability follows the embedding manifest.

AETHER was pretrained for 100 epochs with AlphaEarth pixels and Foursquare POI descriptions using AE-AE and AE-POI contrastive objectives. No CityRep labels, splits, validation results, or benchmark metrics were used for training or checkpoint selection. Direct native-raster rows are released as exact pre-normalization sample_id tables. Availability follows the embedding manifest.
